G-337-015 did the extension Week 16 visit on Tue 3 Nov (ATE start Tue 14 Jul). He held his dose and took it after the visit. Vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, CNS-BFS, labs, ECG, con meds, AEs, contraception (partner IUD plus condoms), compliance count and 12 cartons dispensed.

No biomarker blood or urine this time; I thought those restart at Week 28 in the extension. We also skipped the C-SSRS since his answers have been all "no" for over a year, and Dr. Hall was fine with that.

Thanks,
Max

subject: G-336-010 visit 17 Feb (after Week 52)
body:
Hi Ted,

G-336-010 had a post-Week-52 extension visit on Wed 17 Feb, 89 days after her previous visit on Fri 20 Nov 2026. Vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, ECG, labs, blood and urine biomarkers, C-SSRS, con meds, AEs, contraception (IUS plus condoms), count and dispensing.

We didn't do any questionnaires, since after Week 52 they're all dropped: no CNS-BFS, ALSAQ-40, ROADS or PGIs. She also asked to skip the pregnancy test, since she's been negative every time for two years and has an IUS, and we agreed.

Thanks,
Una

subject: G-342-006 Week 24 done - extension calls scheduled
body:
Hi Fay,

G-342-006 (Baseline Tue 14 Apr 2026) had the Week 24 visit on Mon 5 Oct, a bit later than planned because of his MRI, but still day 174, so inside the window. All Week 24 items were done: endocrine labs, predose PK at 8:20, extension dose at 8:50 double-checked by Jo, postdose PK at 11:00. No CSF (he didn't have a baseline LP). 8 cartons dispensed.

I've set up his extension calendar by study week from Baseline: ATE Week 2 call at Week 26 = Tue 13 Oct, ATE Week 4 visit at Week 28 = Tue 27 Oct, and so on.

Thanks,
Ash

subject: G-313-019 Week 24 + CSF
body:
Hi Nico,

G-313-019 (Baseline Wed 8 Apr 2026, baseline CSF done) had her optional LP on Fri 18 Sep, day 163, so before her first extension dose and inside the Week 24 window. CSF was sent for biomarkers and PK.

The main Week 24 visit was Wed 23 Sep (day 168), which is the visit date we entered in EDC. She came at 7:30 having held her dose. PGI-C and PGI-S first, then the rest of the assessments. ACTH, cortisol, TSH and fT4 drawn at 7:50 with the safety labs, predose PK at 8:00, extension dose at 9:15 after the procedures, confirmed by Rae with an ID check and the time recorded; postdose PK at 1:30 pm. CGI-C last. Urine pregnancy test negative; contraception: BTL plus condoms. Extension drug dispensed.

Thanks,
Bea

subject: G-314-003 ET visit in extension
body:
Hi Jan,

G-314-003 withdrew; last dose Mon 26 Oct (extension week 34; ATE started Mon 2 Mar 2026). ET visit on Thu 29 Oct: vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, CNS-BFS, ECG, labs, biomarkers, C-SSRS, con meds, AEs, contraception, packet return and vital status. We didn't do the ALSAQ-40, ROADS, PGI-C, PGI-S or CGI-C because those aren't needed at an early termination.

Follow-up safety call booked for Mon 23 Nov, 28 days after the last dose.

Thanks,
Kit

subject: G-331-007 trigeminal neuralgia - med plan
body:
Hi team,

G-331-007 (extension) has new trigeminal neuralgia. Her neurologist started carbamazepine 200 mg twice daily on Mon 25 Jan, and it is helping a lot. Since carbamazepine speeds up DNL343 breakdown, I increased her study drug to 3 packets each morning starting Mon 1 Feb to keep her exposure up.

Please update the dosing log.

Dr. Pryce

subject: G-321-013 ATE week 40
body:
Hi Sky,

G-321-013 had his ATE Week 40 visit on Mon 23 Nov (ATE start Mon 9 Feb 2026, so day 287). He took his packets at home at 7 as usual. Vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, CNS-BFS, labs (a bit off: glucose 112 non-fasting, Dr. Hale reviewed, not clinically significant), ECG (QTcF 418), C-SSRS, con meds, AEs (none), contraception (girlfriend on a combined pill; he uses condoms), count and 12 cartons dispensed. No biomarkers, ROADS, PGIs or CGI-C, as they're not scheduled at Week 40.

Thanks,
Ty

subject: G-328-010 into extension
body:
Hi Wren,

G-328-010 moved into the extension at his Week 24 visit on Thu 1 Oct. Back in July Dr. Kemp lowered him to one packet a day for diarrhea, and he stayed on that through the blinded period. For the extension we just kept him on one packet daily (100 mg) since it suits him; no need to bother the monitor about it.

His ATE Week 2 phone call was Thu 15 Oct: AEs reviewed (none new), con meds unchanged, contraception reviewed, and I reminded him to bring all his packets to Week 4. We ran out of time for the compliance part, so we'll cover it at Week 4.

Thanks,
Eve

subject: G-332-004 follow-up call + thank you card
body:
Hi Mia,

I did G-332-004's follow-up safety call on Fri 12 Feb, 28 days after her last dose on Fri 15 Jan, when she finished the extension. No AEs since the last visit; she says her energy is about the same and she's been enjoying short walks with her dog.

She and her husband want to start a family, so she had her IUD removed last week and they've stopped using condoms. I congratulated her; since she's done with the drug, it's no longer a study concern.

She also sent the team a lovely thank-you card and a box of cookies, which are in the kitchen.

Thanks,
Joy

subject: G-340-001 ATE week 4 visit
body:

G-340-001's ATE Week 4 visit was Mon 4 Jan (his extension started Tue 1 Dec, so day 34). Vitals, SVC, ALSFRS-R, labs, ECG, C-SSRS, con meds, AEs (none) and contraception (wife postmenopausal).

He forgot his drug bag at home. Since Week 4 isn't a dispensing visit, there was nothing to count, so I skipped accountability and we'll count everything at Week 8.

Thanks,
Ivy
